name: Grim Batol
summary: Above the eastern Wetlands, Grim Batol's gates remain sealed. A curse drove the Wildhammer dwarves from the fortress, and the Dragonmaw orcs later made it a lair for breeding dragons.

sections.title: A Fortress Twice Cursed
sections.body:
Thane Khardros Wildhammer carved Grim Batol from the jagged mountains east of the marsh after the ancient civil war among the three clans. During the War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron sorceress Modgud besieged the fortress. Khardros struck her down, but with her dying breath, Modgud cast a foul shadow across its stones.

The taint lingered in the halls and made them uninhabitable. The surviving Wildhammer dwarves abandoned their kingdom and migrated north into the Hinterlands.

sections.title: Chains of the Dragon Queen
sections.body:
During the Second War, Orgrim Doomhammer sent the Dragonmaw clan to claim Grim Batol. The warlock Nekros Skullcrusher led them, and they used the ancient artifact called the Demon Soul to enslave the red Dragonqueen Alexstrasza deep beneath the mountain. Chained there, she was forced to hatch broods for the Horde's war effort until a small band of heroes shattered the artifact.

Freed, the enraged Dragon Aspect incinerated the orcs within. Grim Batol became a desolate ruin, watched closely by surviving red dragons.

aliases: can i go inside grim batol
faq.answer: No. The colossal stone gates at the end of the mountain road remain barred to travelers. You can visit only the gates and exterior battlements in the eastern Wetlands mountains.

faq.q: Why did the Wildhammer dwarves abandon it?
aliases: why did dwarves leave grim batol
faq.answer: During the War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron sorceress Modgud laid a vile shadow curse on Grim Batol before she was slain. The taint made the fortress unlivable, driving the Wildhammers to abandon it and build Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What happened to the Dragonmaw orcs who lived here?
aliases: what happened to the orcs here
faq.answer: The mage Rhonin and his companions shattered the Demon Soul and freed the captive Dragonqueen Alexstrasza from her chains. Enraged by her captivity, she and her brood incinerated Nekros Skullcrusher and broke the Dragonmaw presence in the fortress.

faq.q: Who controls Grim Batol right now?
aliases: who lives in grim batol now
faq.answer: Grim Batol lies abandoned. Remnants of the Dragonmaw clan and wild beasts linger in the surrounding crags, while the Red Dragonflight watches the cursed mountain against any return of its dark history.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Grim Batol recalls the War of the Three Hammers. It was once a proud sister city to Ironforge, until Dark Iron sorcery made it unlivable.
For the Horde, Grim Batol recalls the Second War. The Dragonmaw clan used enslaved dragons to conquer the skies before its violent ruin.
